name: yulaw-team-ai-workbench
description: The controlled Skill routing and legal AI workflow entry for the Yu Law team.

displayName.en: Yu Law Legal AI Workflow Entry
displayName.zh: 法律 AI 工作流总入口

displayDescription.en: Uses the public GitHub catalog to recommend the best Skill, waits for lawyer confirmation, and then executes installed capabilities.
displayDescription.zh: 通过公开 GitHub 目录推荐合适的 Skill，等待律师确认后执行已安装能力，并将成果停在待律师复核

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请读取我明确授权的任务或材料，通过公开 GitHub 目录先推荐最合适的法律 Skill，并等待我确认，不要直接执行。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Review my authorized task, recommend the best legal Skill from the public GitHub catalog, and wait for confirmation before execution.

quickPrompts.zh: 请根据我刚刚授权的材料，从 GitHub 目录推荐最合适的法律 Skill，等待我确认后再执行。
quickPrompts.en: Recommend the best legal Skill from the GitHub catalog for the materials I authorized, then wait for confirmation.

quickPrompts.zh: 请分析我指定的计划任务，只给出 Skill 推荐卡，不要直接进入生成中。
quickPrompts.en: Analyze the plan task I specify and show only a Skill recommendation card.
